caption_used: Три кръгови диаграми, представящи разпределението на предприятията, заетостта и нетния оборот по отрасли — индустрия, строителство, търговия и други услуги — за 2021 г. В първата диаграма (Number of Enterprises) индустрията заема 12%, строителството — 8%, търговията — 27%, а другите услуги — 53%. По отношение на заетостта (Number of Persons Employed), индустрията е с дял от 51%, строителството — 9%, като търговията надвишава другите услуги с дялове съответно 21% и 19%. При нетния оборот (Turnover) индустрията и търговията имат приблизително равни дялове от по 31%, като строителството представлява около 10% (3,2 трилиона), а другите услуги — 28%.

The chart compares the distribution of enterprises, employment, and net turnover across four industries: industry, construction, trade, and other services in 2021. There are three donut charts, each representing one of these categories. The number of enterprises chart shows that other services account for 61% (19.0 million), trade for 19% (5.9 million), industry for 12% (3.7 million), and construction for 8% (2.4 million). The number of persons employed chart indicates that industry employs 51% (80.2 million), trade 21% (33.0 million), other services 19% (29.5 million), and construction 9% (13.4 million). The turnover chart reveals that industry and trade have equal shares of 31% (9.8 and 9.9 trillion), other services account for 33% (10.6 trillion), and construction represents 6% (1.9 trillion). A legend is provided at the bottom, associating colors with each industry: yellow for industry, blue for construction, red for trade, and white for other services. The charts are labeled with both percentages and absolute values.

DESCRIPTION: The chart compares the distribution of enterprises, employment, and net turnover across four industries: industry, construction, trade, and other services in 2021, using three donut charts, with a legend associating colors with each industry.
